reviews.reviewText: The quality of work that Scott and Nicole put into every task is astounding. They not only do what is required but go above and beyond to make sure everything is perfect.

As a General Contractor operating in this market for over 40 years, and specializing in interior bathroom remodeling, I have worked with many cleaning crews. Final Touch Cleaning Company stands out for their professionalism, attention to detail, and consistent results.
Scott and his wife are true professionals. They communicate well, get the job done and are detail oriented.
They are the best! I couldn't be happier with the service from Final Touch Cleaning! The team was professional, thorough, and left everything spotless. Highly recommend!

I couldn't be happier with the service from Final Touch Cleaning. From the moment Scott and Nicole arrived, they were professional, efficient, and thorough. Every surface was spotless when they finished.
Final touch cleaning is phenomenal! I own my own remodeling and landscaping company, and they have cleaned up several of my job sites. They are reliable, thorough, and always exceed expectations.
Scott and Nicole are simply awesome! Their attention to even the smallest of details is what impresses me the most. You can tell they truly care about doing an excellent job.
My experience with Scott & Nicole of Final Touch Cleaning Company has been outstanding. Their team is professional, punctual, and leaves no corner untouched. I highly recommend them.
Scott and Nichole did an excellent job cleaning my property. They were professional, showed up on time, and paid attention to every detail. I will definitely be using them again.
I HIGHLY recommend Scott and Nicole and Final Touch Cleaning Company! A+++++ service!! They are two great people who are hardworking, detail oriented, and truly care about the quality of their work.
Friendly, reliable service. The owners are so nice and did an amazing job. I highly recommend Final touch cleaning.

What a great company to do business with! They're honest, reliable and they get the job done. If I could give more than 5 stars I definitely would! I recommend this company 100%!! Keep up the great work!
Scott and Nicole were punctual, professional and very detail oriented. Place sparkled when they finished! I would recommend them to anyone!

I recommend this company highly. I needed some assistance cleaning my home due to illness. I hadn't been able to clean for about a month. Scott and Nicole came and cleaned my house even better than I could clean it on my best day. They are pleasant and trustworthy, cordial and pay close attention to details getting all the nooks and crannies clean as a whistle. If you need a really good cleaning service reach out to Final Touch. Best cleaning service I've had in the past 30 years.

Scott and Nicole of Final Touch Cleaning are excellent cleaners … they are professional and responsible… If they miss anything they will go back and make sure it is taken care of … they do what they say they are going to do. I will definitely be calling them back to do more cleaning jobs!
